experiences.title: AI Engineering Intern, Copperline Health (healthcare software startup)
experiences.description: Part-time internship during the semester. Built a structured extraction pipeline that turns clinical intake notes into JSON using a hosted LLM with a JSON schema, then validates the output with Pydantic and rejects records that fail. Wrote a regression test suite of fixed note examples that runs against a recorded fake provider in CI. All data used was synthetic; I never accessed real patient records.
experiences.outcome: Schema failure rate became visible on a weekly dashboard the team reviews.

experiences.title: Prompt Evaluation Harness
experiences.description: Wrote an open source command-line tool in Python that runs a set of prompts against multiple model providers, stores outputs in SQLite and computes exact-match and rubric-based scores. Supports caching responses so reruns do not cost money.

experiences.title: Machine Learning Course: Linear Models and Neural Nets in NumPy
experiences.description: Implemented logistic regression, softmax regression and a two-layer neural network with backpropagation in NumPy. Verified gradients with finite differences.

experiences.title: Embedded Systems: Gesture Recognition on a Microcontroller
experiences.description: Collected accelerometer data, trained a tiny classifier and deployed it with TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers on an ARM Cortex-M board. Wrote the firmware in C.

experiences.title: Hackathon: Meeting Notes Summarizer
experiences.description: Built a web app in a weekend that summarizes meeting transcripts using an LLM API and extracts action items. I wrote the backend in Flask and the prompt chain; a teammate built the frontend.

experiences.title: Teaching Assistant, Intro to Programming
experiences.description: Led two lab sections each week for an introductory Python course and graded weekly assignments. Wrote lab handouts on debugging with print statements and the Python debugger.
